text:
Maria - Prod PM: Quick sync — proposing an MVP for a Dedicated pilot: tenant-level micro-pools (soft reservations + controlled spillover). Goal: let a few pilot customers buy small reserved lanes with predictable latency and limited burst credits.
Sam - Eng: Sounds good. Need a concrete autoscale + eviction policy, otherwise we'll either waste GPUs or blow customer SLAs.
Kevin - SRE: Agree. Also want clear observability gates: eviction rate, fallback rate, and cost burn per-customer.
Dmitry - Eng Runtime: Runtime can do soft prewarm + per-tenant KV cache pinning. We can implement a two-tier admission: soft (best-effort) vs hard (preemptible) reservations. Example policy snippet we can test:
```
policy:
  tenant_pool: micro
  reservation: 4gpus
  burst_credits: 2x
  prewarm: true
  spillover: public_pool
  eviction_threshold: 0.85 # spill before OOM
  autoscale:
    metric: avg_qps_per_gpu
    scale_up: >70% util for 30s
    scale_down: <40% util for 5m
```
Anna - Sales: Customer ask (Acme): predictable p95 and a small monthly reserved bill. They want a 2-week pilot with 99.9% availability for reserved lanes and a 2x burst window for launches.
Olivia - Customer Success: We'll need an onboarding checklist: network egress rules, KMS, test prompt set, and a playbook for failover to public models. Also confirm data residency for EU customers.
Sam - Eng: Implementation proposal (phases):
- Phase 1 (MVP, 2 sprints): soft reservations + spillover to shared pools, autoscale knobs, basic metrics and dashboard.
- Phase 2 (pilot+): per-tenant cache pinning, burst accounting, and stricter preemption semantics.
Kevin - SRE: Launch criteria (must pass before pilot):
- P95 tail for reserved lane < 120ms for small requests
- Eviction incidents < 0.1% over 24h
- Automatic fallback to public pool with < 2s additional latency added
- Billing telemetry: per-tenant cost delta visible in Console
Dmitry - Eng Runtime: Rough effort: Phase 1 is ~6 dev-weeks (runtime + admission + dashboard). Phase 2 another ~4-6 weeks depending on cache API work.
Maria - Prod PM: Product acceptance checklist (for pilot go/no-go):
- Eng + SRE sign-off on metrics & rollback plan
- Sales/customer success commit to 2 pilot customers and kickoff date
- Legal/compliance quick check (KMS / residency)
- Run a synthetic 24h burst test showing eviction < 0.1%
Kevin - SRE: Monitoring/alerts we need in Ops:
- per-tenant GPU utilization, queued requests, preempt count
- spike detector (5m windows) -> page if fallback rate > 1%
- cost anomaly: if pilot burn > expected by 30% -> page
Anna - Sales: I can lock Acme and one smaller customer. Acme agreed to the 2-week pilot and will provide a production-like prompt set. They asked if we can include a small SLA credit if we miss reserved-lane availability in pilot.
Olivia - Customer Success: I'll coordinate the prompt set and run a dry-run with them in our staging on Tuesday.
Dmitry - Eng Runtime: One technical open question: how do we charge burst credits during spillover? Options: charge reserved tier rate for first N tokens, then public rate, or always reserved rate during burst window. Need Sales input.
Anna - Sales: Prefer first N tokens at reserved rate, then public rate — easier to explain. But legal needs to confirm pricing language.
Sam - Eng: Dev plan notes: keep surge smoothing off by default for pilot. We want observability plain so we can measure before enabling smoothing heuristics.
Maria - Prod PM: Decision ask: eng + SRE + sales OK to proceed with Phase 1 MVP pilot scope and timeline (2 sprints to an internal pilot, 4 weeks to customer pilot)? Need 👍 by EOD Friday.
Kevin - SRE: 👍 from SRE, assuming we get dashboard and synthetic test before customer kickoff.
Dmitry - Eng Runtime: 👍 from runtime, will start a spike this week and add the admission policy scaffold.
Anna - Sales: 👍 — will confirm pricing language with legal and lock pilot customers.
Olivia - Customer Success: I'll schedule the kickoff and draft the onboarding checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: micro-pools-spike -> staging at 2024-06-16 02:00 UTC
Maria - Prod PM: Thanks everyone — I'll update the roadmap doc and add the pilot gates. If anyone has additional hard blockers call them out here.
Sam - Eng: One more ask: include a simple tenant-level smoke test that runs in CI to prevent regressions.
Maria - Prod PM: Good call, adding that to the acceptance checklist.
